description.en_US: Phone-style screen time tracking with Daily and Weekly tabs. Focus accounting via Quickshell's native ToplevelManager (event-driven, pauses while locked, suspend gaps not counted) keeps a browsable 30-day history. Daily shows a selected day's total, app ranking, AI work summary, and today's hourly histogram. Weekly shows an ISO calendar-week total, same-weekday comparison with last week, per-app comparison, honest missing-day charts, and a Monday-to-Sunday hourly heatmap accumulated from v1.3 onward. A separate AI work-time dimension samples agent process trees even while unfocused or locked. Bar pill, IPC detail panel, and optional Tier B sidebar tile included.
description.zh_TW: 手機風格的螢幕使用時間統計，詳情分成「每日／週報」。以 Quickshell 原生 ToplevelManager 做焦點記帳（事件驅動、鎖屏暫停、休眠時段不入帳），保留可瀏覽的 30 天歷史。「每日」顯示選定日期總時長、應用排行、AI 工作摘要與今日時段圖；「週報」顯示 ISO 日曆週總時長、與上週同一批星期的總量及各應用比較、誠實標示缺日的圖表，以及從 1.3 起累積的週一至週日時段熱力圖。另有獨立 AI 工作時長維度，即使未聚焦或鎖屏仍會取樣 agent 程序樹。含 Bar 藥丸、IPC 詳情面板與可選 Tier B 側欄磁貼。

patches.content:
DelegateChoice { roleValue: "screentime"; AndroidQuickToggleButton {
        required property int index
        required property var modelData
        buttonIndex: root.startingIndex + index
        buttonData: modelData
        editMode: root.editMode
        expandedSize: modelData.size > 1
        baseCellWidth: root.baseCellWidth
        baseCellHeight: root.baseCellHeight
        cellSpacing: root.spacing
        cellSize: modelData.size
        name: Translation.tr("Screen time")
        tooltipText: Translation.tr("Screen time")
        buttonIcon: "hourglass_bottom"
        toggled: false
        mainAction: () => Quickshell.execDetached(["qs", "-c", "ii", "ipc", "--any-display", "call", "screentime", "toggleDetails"])
    } }
